title: Build fails when depending on `winit` with `android-game-activity` feature enabled
body:
**Describe the bug**
[This example](https://github.com/metent/rust-android-examples/tree/0beec1d0b8c2f3311852b08318d3a7d31a404c84/agdk-eframe) fails to build with latest egui.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Clone [this repository](https://github.com/metent/rust-android-examples).
2. Navigate to `agdk-eframe` directory.
3. Follow the instructions in `README.md` to build the example.
4. Build fails with the following error.

**Expected behavior**
The example should build successfully.

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Linux
 - Version: master branch

**Additional context**
According to the error log, the build probably fails because two conflicting features `native-activity` and `game-activity` are enabled at the same time. `android-game-activity` feature is enabled for `winit` dependency in the example and `native-activity` is enabled by `egui-winit`. The example builds successfully if [this line](https://github.com/emilk/egui/blob/530e9f667c0969b09edb68f7701f20c52a273d3a/crates/egui-winit/Cargo.toml#L76) is removed.
